hero.headline: Your money, clear and in one place.
hero.subtitle: Track balances, log movements, and see where your money goes — built for your phone.

problems.title: Spending isn’t the problem. Blind spots are.
problems.subtitle: Savv helps you regain control with what you can already do today.

scattered.title: Scattered balances
scattered.description: Multiple accounts, one view of the total and each balance.

opaque.title: Spending without a pattern
opaque.description: Categories and summaries to see where money actually goes.

unplanned.title: A month without limits
unplanned.description: Budgets and upcoming payments so you can plan, not only react.

product.title: Everything you need to track your finances
product.subtitle: The same screens you use in the app, designed for everyday use.

accounts.title: All your accounts, one net worth
accounts.subtitle: Add the accounts you use, see each balance, and the total together.

multiple.title: Multiple accounts
multiple.description: Keep every balance up to date without switching tools.

balance.title: Current balance
balance.description: Know what’s available right now, account by account.

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.description: See the total of your accounts in a single number.

timeline.title: Balance over time
timeline.description: Follow how your money changes across time.

movements.title: Every movement counts
movements.subtitle: Income, expenses, and transfers build a real picture of your finances.

income.title: Income
income.description: Record salaries, freelance work, and any money coming in.

expense.title: Expenses
expense.description: Log daily spending and keep it organized with categories.

transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.description: Move money between accounts without treating it as income or expense.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group movements so you can understand where money goes.

movements.transferNote: A transfer between accounts is an internal move — it does not count as income or spending in your metrics.

analytics.title: See what’s happening
analytics.subtitle: You don’t just record: you see monthly income and expenses, spend by category, and how your balance evolves.

month.title: Monthly income and expenses
month.description: A clear snapshot of money in versus money out.

byCategory.title: Spend by category
byCategory.description: See which categories take most of your money.

comparison.title: Category comparison
comparison.description: Compare this month with your average and your budget.

evolution.title: Balance evolution
evolution.description: Watch how balances move over time, not just today.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set category limits and track progress as you spend.

planning.title: Available today. Coming next.
planning.subtitle: Use what’s ready now — and see where the product is heading.

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.description: Future-dated movements, visible before they affect today’s balance.

budgets.title: Category budgets
budgets.description: Set limits and track progress as you spend.

recurring.title: Recurring & fixed expenses
recurring.description: Rent, subscriptions, and other monthly commitments — without retyping them.

installments.title: Installments
installments.description: Break large purchases into scheduled payments you can follow.

projection.title: Balance projection
projection.description: Estimate how your balance may look after upcoming commitments.

planning.roadmapNote: These capabilities are part of the product direction and may roll out gradually.

1.title: Create your accounts

2.title: Log movements
2.description: Income, expenses, and transfers to keep balances accurate.

3.title: Organize and budget
3.description: Categories and limits to understand and control spending.

4.title: Review your situation
4.description: Net worth, balance evolution, and spend by category.

finalCta.title: Start seeing your money clearly
